caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing desk, also known as a slant-front desk or bureau, with a warm brown color and visible wood grain texture. The desk has a rectangular shape and features a slanted front panel that appears to function as a hinged writing surface, with a keyhole at the top center indicating it can be locked. Below the slanting panel, there are four horizontal drawers, each equipped with two brass handles and a central keyhole for locking. The desk sits on short, bracket-style feet, which are wider at the base, supporting the rectangular frame. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, offering no additional objects or decorative elements, which emphasizes the central placement of the desk in the composition.
title: Writing Desk
